cases.title: Two prerequisite branches and one join
cases.reason: Both branches and their AND join are retained; no cycle or replacement is introduced.
cases.expected_math: Edges P→S, P→G, S→U, G→U. P reaches U by two paths; P,S,G,U is one topological order.

cases.title: A join explicitly replaced by a single branch
cases.reason: OPS explicitly removes G as a prerequisite of U, rather than merely omitting a repeated statement.
cases.expected_math: Parent requires S→U and G→U. Proposed replacement permits S,U,G, which violates G→U.

cases.title: A four-step cycle across role boundaries
cases.reason: The combined graph contains a directed cycle although some individual role graphs are acyclic.
cases.expected_math: A→B→C→D→A; no topological order exists.

cases.title: An action required to precede itself
cases.reason: A self-loop is impossible under strict finish-before-start semantics; DEV2 creates it and OPS retains it.
cases.expected_math: X→X is a directed cycle of length one.

cases.title: Cyclic document links with acyclic actions
cases.reason: Only the execution graph is constrained to be acyclic; a reference cycle does not create an execution cycle.
cases.expected_math: Execution B→V→D is acyclic. Alpha↔Beta contains reference edges only.

cases.title: Repeated names in separate release scopes
cases.reason: Opposite-looking edges use distinct nodes and create no common directed cycle.
cases.expected_math: East-Pack→East-Check and West-Check→West-Pack are two disjoint edges.

cases.title: One prerequisite direction explicitly unresolved
cases.reason: One permitted completion is acyclic, and the other creates a cycle. The proposed handling preserves the parent constraint.
cases.expected_math: Add A→C: DAG. Add C→A: A→B→C→A cycle. Overall unresolved.

cases.title: Uncertain timestamps on a required handoff
cases.reason: The rule is retained, but the reported event order can satisfy or violate it.
cases.expected_math: U at 7 is before V finishes at 8; U at 9 is after. Reported-event conformity is unresolved.

cases.title: A redundant transitive edge preserves the graph
cases.reason: The extra edge agrees with existing reachability and introduces no cycle.
cases.expected_math: A→B→C→D plus A→D remains a DAG; A reaches C and D.

cases.title: Responsibility handoff is not a prerequisite cycle
cases.reason: The reporting graph may have return edges while the action graph remains acyclic.
cases.expected_math: Execution graph V→D is acyclic. PM↔DEV reporting edges are not strict prerequisite edges.

cases.title: Two valid topological orders for parallel branches
cases.reason: Both sequences are linear extensions of the same diamond partial order.
cases.expected_math: A,C,B,D and A,B,C,D satisfy A→B,A→C,B→D,C→D.

cases.title: An explicit replacement breaks transitive authorization
cases.reason: DEV2 reverses the parent edge and OPS permits publication before approval, removing mandatory reachability.
cases.expected_math: Replacement edges S→A,S→P do not give A→P; S,P,A is a violating ordering.

cases.title: A fork-join critical path at the time limit
cases.family: Graph longest path and parallel duration
cases.reason: The longer branch is B; the complete duration exactly meets the cap.
cases.expected_math: 3+max(4+5,11)+4=18 minutes. Longest path Setup→B→Join.

cases.title: A mandatory transfer delay extends the critical path
cases.family: Graph weighted path with transfer delay
cases.reason: The B/transfer branch controls the finish and exceeds the parent cap by one minute.
cases.expected_math: 2+max(6,8+3)+5=18>17 minutes; excess 1 minute.

cases.title: A bounded unknown branch controls deadline uncertainty
cases.family: Graph critical path with uncertain duration
cases.reason: A shorter B meets the deadline while a longer B misses it; the original text supplies no unique duration.
cases.expected_math: 2+max(7,B)+5 yields [14,17]; B=6 gives14, B=10 gives17. Cap16 is unresolved.

cases.title: Nonnegative transport cannot rescue an over-cap purchase
cases.reason: The fixed component alone exceeds the cap; unknown nonnegative transport cannot reverse the violation.
cases.expected_math: 8500+transport≥8500>8200; excess at least USD300.

cases.title: Mixed time units with a shared stopping rule
cases.family: Unit conversion and inherited stopping condition
cases.reason: The planned duration is exactly 900 seconds and both stopping conditions remain effective.
cases.expected_math: 4×60+300+360=900 seconds=15 minutes; record_count≤240 AND elapsed_seconds≤900.

cases.title: A forbidden region introduced through a union
cases.reason: OPS explicitly exports ES outside the allowed set; DEV2 preparation alone is not treated as an export event.
cases.expected_math: {DE,FR}∪{IE,ES}={DE,FR,IE,ES}; difference from allowed set is {ES}.

cases.title: An unreadable version identity blocks package verification
cases.reason: The plans preserve the boundary, but one supplied artifact can match or fail the required version.
cases.expected_math: Guide=rc34 satisfies equality; guide=rc35 does not. Existing identity evidence is unresolved.

cases.title: Contradictory simultaneous gate requirements
cases.reason: The conjunction is unsatisfiable; DEV2 introduces the contradiction and OPS explicitly retains it.
cases.expected_math: release_ready∧¬release_ready has zero satisfying assignments.
